WHO WE SERVE & WHAT WE BRING

Built for UK technical
and commercial leaders.

We work with business owners, managing directors, commercial directors, branch managers and hiring leaders across electrical wholesale, technical distribution, construction, M&E contracting and engineering.

Generic recruitment agencies treat technical sectors as high-volume CV exercises, and generic software vendors sell complex tools without understanding how a branch or trade desk actually operates.

Power-Up Talent brings specialist executive and commercial search, practical workplace coaching and seven focused business platforms under one roof — so the people you hire have the habits and tools to succeed.

WHY RECRUITMENT, COACHING & TECHNOLOGY SIT TOGETHER

One joined-up approach
to commercial growth.

Each pillar solves a distinct problem, and they reinforce one another when connected around your business.

01 / RECRUITMENT & HEADHUNTING

Secure the right people

A strong commercial plan starts with the right leadership, branch managers and sales specialists in post.

  • Commercial brief agreed before search begins
  • Discreet approach to proven sector performers
  • Structured assessment against real job requirements
02 / COACHING & DEVELOPMENT

Build consistent everyday habits

Appointing a leader or sales rep is only step one. Practical coaching builds the discovery, quote follow-up and margin habits that turn talent into results.

  • Workshops and coaching tied to live accounts and quotes
  • Clear weekly operating rhythms for branch managers
  • Trackable operational indicators agreed up front
03 / AI & BUSINESS PLATFORMS

Give teams clear ownership and visibility

Our seven platforms give staff one place for customer enquiries, CRM renewals, sales action queues, delivery onboarding and campaign outcome reporting.

  • Human-reviewed workflows and explicit operator handovers
  • Separate Business CRM and Personal CRM boundaries
  • Honest distinction between built features and expansion areas

HOW WE OPERATE

Clear standards.
Human judgement first.

The principles that govern every search mandate, coaching programme and platform walkthrough.

01 / COMMERCIAL CLARITY

Direct, honest advice

We state clearly what a candidate has delivered, what a coaching sprint will track, and which platform capabilities are ready to try now versus in development.

02 / HUMAN IN CONTROL

Technology supports; people decide

Across our platforms, outreach drafts, AI Team briefs and Sales-to-Delivery handovers remain under explicit human review and operator confirmation.

03 / WRITTEN COMMITMENTS

Defined scope & confidentiality

We routinely sign non-disclosure agreements, protect candidate confidentiality and set out any agreed sector or territory exclusivity in writing.
